name: use-omp-manual-invocation
reason: Use the native OMP command for this hidden skill.

name: link-formal-creation
reason: Keep the corresponding creation method reachable from the installed skill.

name: locate-explicit-project-skill
reason: Accept the explicit project skill file even when it is outside Suite discovery.
anchor: Read each one you find, or the one the user named.
replace: Read the supplied project `SKILL.md` by its explicit path, or read each candidate you find in the project (usually `verification/verify-*/SKILL.md`). The Suite skill catalog is not a project file index.

name: name-native-creation-entry
reason: Use the native creation command when no project verification exists.
anchor: If no verify skill exists, stop and point at `/create-formal-verification-skill`.
